A new chapter for an existing structure.

Construction and DevelopmentStructures and Engineering

Experience of the BOW Structures and BOW Projects team prior to BOW. These projects are not BOW contracts.

Adina Apartment Hotel is highlighted in the BOW Structures profile as an example of refurbishment and strengthening, with a six-level office building extended to 18 levels.

The described engineering scope includes construction-stage inspections and methodology, temporary foundation and crane support works, a new core, two concrete transfer floors and ten levels of cross-laminated timber.

Scope delivered by the team

  • Refurbishment and strengthening from 6 to 18 levels
  • Temporary works for core demolition
  • Engineering for ten levels of cross-laminated timber
